# MIT Admissions

> > Official MIT Admissions blog featuring student perspectives on academic life, campus culture, and the undergraduate experience at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.

Written by current MIT students like Aiden H. '28, Emiko P. '25, and Ellie F. '28, these blogs cover everything from engineering coursework and mathematical culture to athletics, dining in Boston, and navigating the admissions process. The site provides authentic insights into student life, extracurriculars, and personal growth at MIT.

## Key Topics

- MIT student life and campus culture
- Engineering education and Course 16 (Aero/Astro)
- Mathematics at MIT (Course 18, topology, combinatorics)
- Student bloggers (Aiden H. '28, Emiko P. '25, Ellie F. '28, Veronica P. '27)
- Mechanical engineering (2.009 capstone)
- MIT slang and mathematical jargon
- Boston dining and food culture
- Athletics and varsity sports
- First-year programs (DesignPlus, STARS@MIT)
- Student extracurriculars and clubs
- Personal growth and reflection
- Admissions support and community
- Campus traditions and projects
- HackMIT and hackathons

## Academics & Engineering

- [2.009 LIVE BLOG 2025](https://mitadmissions.org/blogs/entry/2-009-live-blog-2025-2): Live coverage of 2.009 mechanical engineering capstone showcase event
- [What is engineering, anyways?](https://mitadmissions.org/blogs/entry/what-is-engineering-anyways): Student perspective on engineering definition and major selection process
- [thoughts on math@MIT!](https://mitadmissions.org/blogs/entry/thoughts-on-mathmit): Course 18 math major perspectives on topology, combinatorics, and community
- [Mathisms](https://mitadmissions.org/blogs/entry/mathisms): Student blog on MIT's unique mathematical jargon and campus slang culture
- [[Joint Post] DesignPlus](https://mitadmissions.org/blogs/entry/joint-post-designplus): Student experience in DesignPlus first-year learning community program

## Student Life & Personal Growth

- [parallels or juxtapositions](https://mitadmissions.org/blogs/entry/parallels-or-juxtapositions): Sophomore reflection on academic uncertainty and personal growth at MIT
- [Hi again (and goodbye)](https://mitadmissions.org/blogs/entry/hi-again-and-goodbye): Alumni farewell post reflecting on MIT career and life after graduation
- [letter to my 2023 self](https://mitadmissions.org/blogs/entry/letter-to-my-2023-self): Freshman year-end reflection letter on growth and travel adventures
- [The Periodic Table of MIT](https://mitadmissions.org/blogs/entry/the-periodic-table-of-mit): Interactive periodic table project showcasing MIT life and culture
- [Reflections from the STARS@MIT Fly-In](https://mitadmissions.org/blogs/entry/some-reflections-from-the-starsmit-fly-in): Rural and small-town student reflections from STARS@MIT campus visit

## Admissions & Prospective Students

- [Open Thread: Not Admitted Early](https://mitadmissions.org/blogs/entry/open-thread-not-admitted-early-2024): Support thread for Class of 2029 early action applicants not admitted

## Extracurriculars & Activities

- [dance dance dance!](https://mitadmissions.org/blogs/entry/dance-dance-dance): First-year experience with dance auditions and performing arts at MIT
- [look at the stars](https://mitadmissions.org/blogs/entry/look-at-the-stars): HackMIT hackathon planning experience and student club involvement

## Athletics & Sports

- [Lax bros](https://mitadmissions.org/blogs/entry/lax-bros): Student athlete interviews about varsity lacrosse at Roberts Field
- [We're So Back](https://mitadmissions.org/blogs/entry/were-so-back): Women's soccer preseason coverage with team bonding and scrimmages
- [Unveiling the New Varsity Weight Room](https://mitadmissions.org/blogs/entry/unveiling-the-new-varsity-weight-room): Tour of renovated varsity athletics strength training facility

## Optional

- [I LOVE TATTE💖💖💖](https://mitadmissions.org/blogs/entry/i-love-tatte%f0%9f%92%96%f0%9f%92%96%f0%9f%92%96): Student review of Tatte bakery and Boston dining near MIT campus
- [Eating my words at Area Four](https://mitadmissions.org/blogs/entry/eating-my-words-at-area-four): Food review of Area Four pizza blending differential geometry concepts
- [a penny for your thoughts?](https://mitadmissions.org/blogs/entry/a-penny-for-your-thoughts-2): Etymology and historical analysis of currency idioms and inflation
- [Acception Therapy](https://mitadmissions.org/blogs/entry/acception-therapy): Personal essay on airplane trading cards, travel, and acceptance therapy
